shared_memories: It is the weekend, and three employees are working overtime in the office.
They are working overtime because a client made unexpected last-minute changes to the requirements, forcing the team to adjust the report and slides over the weekend.
All employees' salary is closely tied to monthly performance evaluations.
The three employees sit at nearby desks, allowing them to talk easily.
A half-finished cup of coffee sits on one desk, while another desk has neatly stacked documents and a calculator.
The office clock shows mid-morning, and the room is quiet except for the soft hum of a printer in the corner.
One employee occasionally sighs or rubs their temples, showing signs of mild stress from multitasking.
The employees occasionally ask each other questions about formatting, data sources, and task allocation.
The atmosphere is relatively calm but carries a sense of shared busyness typical of office work.
Their manager is not in the room, so they interact freely without formal supervision.
scenario.gm_facts_desc: General knowledge of the office overtime environment and employee interactions.
